first.rationale: Prioritize the directly deteriorating onboarding-completion metric with an intervention that previously improved completion, time-to-value, and early adoption. Verify the onboarding result and the documented retention cost of promotional pricing before committing; competitor pricing pressure does not justify a tactic known to compromise sustainable value.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. It directly addresses the 4% decline in onboarding completion and has confirmed durable evidence: completion increased 13%, time-to-value fell 2.1 days, and 30-day retention increased 3%. Do not use promotional pricing despite competitive pressure: its qualified-revenue gain came with a 12% 30-day retention decline and failure to survive the first renewal cycle, which conflicts with sustainable long-term qualified revenue.
